objective: Under the same caption task, model families, and 4096-coordinate information budget, obtain strict finite-hypothesis compression certificates over a declared finite eligible-image distribution using independent with-replacement draws, while comparing independent module coordinates with a globally shared coordinate vector.

git.frozen_protocol_commit_binding: resolve the annotated stage2-protocol-v2 tag target at runtime and require it to equal HEAD and to contain this exact protocol SHA256; the protocol cannot embed the hash of the commit that contains itself

M2.description: independent vision, projector, and language coordinates

model.target_order: full canonical UTF-8 name ascending; A then B within each target; C-order row-major flattening

projector_base.base_tensor_hash_protocol: for each of four tensors, SHA256 of C-order little-endian float32 raw bytes

deterministic_mapping.string_serialization: uint32 little-endian UTF-8 byte length followed by UTF-8 bytes

count_scope.M2: separate counts inside vision, projector, and language
count_scope.M3: one global count across all vision, projector, and language A/B elements

usage_statistics.includes: M1 historical mapping and every M0/M2/M3 predeclared mapping root; each group records dimension, min, max, mean, histogram, histogram SHA256, and mapping SHA256

target_distribution.unit: one exact-image unit with one deterministically selected strict-token-eligible canonical conversation
target_distribution.probability: uniform over the frozen post-filter eligible catalog
target_distribution.independence_claim: train and validation draw indices are generated independently with replacement from the fixed catalog

phash.acceptance_rule: distance greater than 6 from every fixed historical image only

conversation_canonicalization.duplicate_image_rule: among selected catalog-source rows with the same exact image, retain the strict-token-eligible representative with minimum representative_key

catalog.selection_rule: take the 50000 source row indices with lowest (rank digest, source row index) before reading row contents

candidate_requirements: source row index belongs to the frozen value-independent catalog-row set
exact image absent from the complete v2 historical receipt
pHash distance greater than 6 from every fixed historical image
exactly one assistant answer span is uniquely located
full VLM token sequence length is at most 450
image, text, and target token metadata reproduce exactly

independent_draws.digest_integer: SHA256 digest interpreted as unsigned 256-bit big-endian
independent_draws.unbiased_index_rule: for catalog size N, accept r only when r < floor(2^256/N)*N and return r modulo N; otherwise increment retry_index

post_tag_receipts.binding: formal data must use the v2 frozen output paths; catalog, draw streams, split manifest, independent verification, and replay verification must bind the exact frozen v2 protocol and hashes

development.purpose: reuse the pre-confirmation v1 learning-rate selection without reopening model selection

legacy_data_semantics.purpose: preserve the complete already-exposed 10000/2000 development sets used only for LR selection
legacy_data_semantics.image_marker_replacement: replace every <image> in non-system turns with 64 image tokens, matching the historical VLMDataset
legacy_data_semantics.sequence_rule: construct the complete chat template and truncate to the first 450 token IDs
legacy_data_semantics.target_rule: use all assistant-span token IDs present in the truncated VLM sequence and place the identical IDs in every model group
legacy_data_semantics.assistant_eos_exception: a target cut by the legacy 450-token truncation need not contain EOS; this exception is forbidden for confirmation data

development.risk_source: full quantized decoded development training risk
development.M0_rule: minimize arithmetic mean bound over three mapping-root/seed pairs
development.M1_rule: minimize arithmetic mean bound over train seeds 42, 43, and 44
development.M2_M3_rule: choose one shared LR minimizing the equal-weight mean of all six M2/M3 bounds
development.tie_rule: choose the smallest learning rate among candidates whose mean is no more than the global minimum plus 1e-4

v2_reuse.reason: v2 changes only confirmation sampling and audit guards; model, training, codec, risk, and bound behavior remain unchanged
v2_reuse.rerun_trigger: rerun all 36 development experiments if model, training, quantization, risk, or bound behavior changes

training.epoch_permutation: torch.randperm with a CPU torch.Generator seeded by train_seed+epoch_index; save permutation SHA256
training.formal_data_semantics: 10000 independent with-replacement draws from the frozen v2 eligible-image catalog

gpu_selection_rule: exclude GPUs with active compute processes
break exact free-memory ties by ascending GPU UUID

compression.zero_vector: scale float32 zero and every stored symbol byte equals 3

evaluation.risk_aggregation: mean target-token risk inside each draw, then equal mean over independent with-replacement draws
evaluation.nonvacuous_margin: random baseline minus raw compression upper bound
evaluation.independent_sample_unit: one catalog draw; repeated image values remain distinct independent draws

diagnostics.pairing: sort validation draws by (image SHA256, sample_id), split into equal halves, and choose the smallest cyclic offset of the second half for which every paired image SHA256 differs; swap inside all pairs
diagnostics.shuffle_effect_unit: mean of the two mismatch-minus-correct effects inside each disjoint pair
diagnostics.sample_identity: sample_id and draw_index; exact image SHA256 may repeat
diagnostics.pairing_failure: stop if no unequal-image perfect pairing exists; do not resample validation

structure: M2 and M3 target sets are identical
initialization: all zero-coordinate low-rank updates are exactly zero
all base tensors and configurations match their recorded hashes
M1, zero-coordinate M2, and zero-coordinate M3 projector outputs match on deterministic CPU float32 tensors with rtol 0 and atol 1e-6
gradient: M0 has gradients only on its language coordinate
M1 has gradients only on its two projector coordinates
M2 has nonzero gradients on all three coordinate groups
separate module-enabled backward probes show vision, projector, and language contributions to M3
all base parameter gradients are None
mapping: every coordinate has positive use count for every predeclared applicable mapping root
M3 counts are global rather than per module
mapping hashes and use-count histogram hashes reproduce
codec: MMS2 independently decodes using frozen assets, code, protocol, and adapter only
reported complexity equals exact adapter file bytes times eight
two clean decodes have identical canonical model hashes
data: eligible catalog contains at least 12000 units and is exact-image unique
every eligible catalog image is absent from exact history and has pHash distance greater than six from fixed history
catalog row-index selection is independent of row contents and reproduces
train and validation draw indices reproduce exactly from their domain-separated streams
draws are with replacement and no duplicate or cross-split overlap triggers rejection or redraw
all four groups have identical target token IDs per draw
catalog, draw, membership, independent-verification, and replay receipts reproduce
runtime_integrity: formal execution resolves the annotated protocol tag and frozen commits
tracked worktree is clean and untracked paths are limited to declared output roots
every implementation blob and current implementation file matches the frozen v2 protocol SHA256
model loading rejects every missing language or lm_head tensor and every unexpected tensor
formal data and every stage receipt bind the exact v2 protocol reference

model_vlm_allowed_changes: gradient-enabled vision forward only when a trainable vision adapter exists

execution_order: preserve and audit immutable Stage 2 v1 artifacts
merge all Stage 2 v1 confirmation images into the fixed v2 history exclusion
create isolated v2 branch and protocol draft
implement independent with-replacement catalog sampling and runtime audit guards
pass all unit tests and 256-sample behavior-preserving smoke tests
verify model loading and v2 draw replay
reuse the frozen v1 learning rates only if model/training/codec/risk/bound behavior is unchanged
materialize and independently commit final v2 protocol
generate the eligible catalog and v2 confirmation draws only after the tag
independently verify and replay the catalog and draws
run all ten formal models in the predeclared order
summarize all roots without post-hoc selection
finalize v2 report, artifact manifest, and v1-v2 comparison

failure_policy.confirmation_failure_action: retain failure receipt, repair only the external cause, and restart the exact run from the beginning on the same data and protocol
expected_preflight_stops: no idle A40 satisfies the deterministic selection rule
a predeclared mapping root leaves at least one coordinate unused
fewer than 12000 eligible catalog units remain after fixed-history and token eligibility filters
model, training, codec, risk, or bound behavior differs from v1 without rerunning development selection
any v2 runtime-integrity or independent-draw replay check fails
failure_policy.other_stop_conditions: any failed test, hash, asset, data, environment, protocol, numerical, or reproducibility invariant
forbidden_reactions: remove already exposed v1 images from history
reduce catalog capacity, minimum catalog units, or confirmation draw counts
reject or redraw repeated units or cross-split overlaps
change seed or mapping root after confirmation begins
drop an unfavorable or failed formal run
upgrade descriptive diagnostics into post-hoc formal tests
overwrite any v1 result or receipt

allowed_claims: whether visual conditioning changes empirical risk for these frozen hypotheses
whether these VLM hypotheses require more encoded bits
whether their compression bounds are looser than the language-only counterparts
whether shared coordinates outperform independent module coordinates across the three predeclared mappings
descriptive sensitivity to correct, mismatched, and absent images
forbidden_claims: all visual redundancy has been explained
a nonvacuous NLL bound proves strong visual reasoning
interpretation.certificate_scope: the finite uniform empirical distribution over the frozen v2 eligible-image catalog
interpretation.v2_required_claim_gate: strict certificate language is allowed only after all v2 sampling, runtime-integrity, formal-run, and final-artifact audits pass

pending_before_freeze: prove v1 behavior unchanged outside data identity, duplicate-aware bookkeeping, diagnostics pairing, and audit guards
freeze implementation file hashes and implementation commit
freeze environment receipt, pip-freeze hash, and selected A40 UUID
freeze final protocol commit and annotated tag
